title: General Fungal DNA Extraction
author: Angie Macias
materials: Sterilize some metal scrapers with flame and 95 % (v/v) Ethyl Alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #E7023 .
Flame-sterilize and cool scrapers between samples.

Using a P1000 micropipette, transfer supernatant to each tube containing isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907 and gently mix by inversion. It's better to leave some liquid than to carry bits of the protein pellet into the next step.

Using a P1000 micropipette, transfer supernatant to each tube containing isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907 and gently mix by inversion. It's better to leave some liquid than to carry bits of the protein pellet into the next step.

steps.title: Set water bath to 65 °C
steps.instruction: Turn on the hot water bath and set the temperature to 65 °C.

steps.title: Label and allocate tubes
steps.instruction: Pull two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes per sample, label both with the short sample name; label one of the two tubes with an “I” to indicate it will receive isopropyl alcohol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #W292907).

steps.title: Add lysis and isopropanol reagents
steps.instruction: To the tube without “I”, add 200 µL Cell Lysis Solution (Wizard Genomic, Promega Catalog #A7933) or Nuclei Lysis Solution (Promega Catalog #A7943). To the tube labeled “I”, add 600 µL isopropyl alcohol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #W292907).

steps.title: Warm elution buffer
steps.instruction: Place a tube containing 250 µL Elution Buffer pH 8.0 (Alfa Aesar, Catalog #J61558) into the 65 °C water bath to warm.

steps.title: Add fungal tissue
steps.instruction: Add a half pea‑sized amount of young hyphal fungal tissue (or alternatively, a pea‑sized pellet of mycelium grown in liquid culture) to each tube that contains Cell Lysis Solution (Promega Catalog #A7933).

steps.title: Macerate tissue
steps.instruction: Using a new sterile micropestle, macerate each sample until the tissue is homogeneous.

steps.title: Incubate samples 30 min
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a floating rack and incubate directly in the 65 °C water bath for 30 minutes (00:30:00).

steps.title: Vortex then re‑incubate
steps.instruction: Remove tubes, vortex for 3 seconds (00:00:03), then return them to the 65 °C water bath for an additional 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool samples
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the water bath and allow them to cool on the bench for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Add protein precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution (Promega Catalog #A7953) to each tube and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge 3 min
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 3 minutes at 14,000 rpm (temperature not specified). Proteins will form a large pellet; then unload samples carefully into a rack.

steps.title: Centrifuge 1 min
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 1 minute at 14,000 rpm (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant into a waste container, taking care not to lose the white DNA pellet.

steps.title: Add 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70 % (v/v) ethyl alcohol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #E7023) to each tube and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 1 minute at 14,000 rpm (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Discard ethanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Repeat step “Remove supernatant”: carefully pour off the ethanol supernatant without disturbing the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Open the tubes and invert them onto a clean paper towel (a tube rack can be placed on the lids to hold the tubes). Allow the pellet to air‑dry.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL warmed Elution Buffer pH 8.0 (250 µL stock, Alfa Aesar, Catalog #J61558) to each tube.

steps.title: Store DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place fully labeled tubes in a box (not a tube rack) and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Add extra lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Cell Lysis Solution (Wizard Genomic, Promega Catalog #A7933) to each tube to bring the total volume of lysis reagent to 600 µL (optional, if additional lysis is required).
